scope: Read-only author artifacts; raw data/codebook/survey instruments plus analysis and currently available manuscript template. No holdout, original target paper, target code, published numerical results, or another attempt were read.
method: Independent base-R parsing using manually transcribed fixed-column endpoints from eligible codebook; lm/QR estimation, direct HC1 sandwich, native OLS vcov, and separate hand group-mean formulas. Did not import or rerun author analysis.
original_analytical_correctness_verdict: pass: internally correct execution of the declared complete-pair descriptive change contrast and supporting specifications; no numerical or estimator error found. This is not a historical-fidelity verdict against a withheld article.

data_audit.closure_post_components: All six permanently closed rows record EMPFT2=EMPPT2=NMGRS2=0; no analyst imputation needed. Other closure statuses and missing components are not automatically zero.
data_audit.fte_definition: EMPFT+NMGRS+0.5*EMPPT; any required component missing makes FTE missing. Survey instrument explicitly separates managers from nonmanagement employees.

source_id_duplicate.treatment: Both retained; source order row_id used. No merge or silent deduplication.

data_audit.gap_missingness: PA exposure is zero by definition even when wage is missing. NJ missing baseline wage gives missing gap and is omitted from gap regressions. Gap regressions n=368 verified.
data_audit.alternative_sample: Excluding managers removes that component requirement, increasing n to391; template explicitly discloses this.

inference.analytical_covariance: HC1 is n/(n-k) times the OLS residual sandwich; conventional OLS and separate-group SE computed correctly.
inference.bootstrap: Author code resamples paired restaurants separately within each state, 2000 draws, fixed seed19920401, percentile .025/.975. Independent base-R20000 draws use a different RNG and produce CI[0.146551779935276,5.40057200647249], compatible with author2k percentile CI[0.19278317152103563,5.273771035598704]. Exact same-RNG bootstrap was not needed for analytical correctness.
inference.claim_boundary: Current template.tex:76,81,135,169-183 correctly conditions restaurant SE/bootstrap on observed state paths and independent restaurant errors. It explicitly rejects statewide causal significance and explains that restaurant resampling cannot learn uncertainty from state shocks. Parallel trends/anticipation/spillover/selection remain unverified identifying assumptions.
inference.verdict: pass for stated conditional/descriptive claims; cannot establish unconditional policy causal uncertainty with these two jurisdictions.

binding_audit.two_segment_numeric_keys: All conclusion-carrying displayed table fields use compatible result_id.field keys. Nested coefficient dictionaries and audit arrays are ancillary metadata ignored by frozen checker, not displayed table numbers.
binding_audit.whole_manuscript_status: Final main.tex is still being generated; no final manuscript hash/coverage verdict is asserted. Current template uses generated @B:key@ placeholders and table insertion markers for all four modules. Root should run frozen check_result_bindings.py on the fully expanded final main.tex after freeze.
binding_audit.required_bindings_scope: Only eight primary fields are required by current results.json. Author table macros cover main, means, robustness and auxiliary outcomes; the frozen checker validates bindings present but does not require every numerical result to be displayed.

copied_or_typed_result_check.numerical_verdict: No evidence of a manually typed value that conflicts with raw data. Primary estimate and SE, supporting specs, robustness and outcomes all independently match.
copied_or_typed_result_check.originality_limit: Numerical agreement alone cannot establish the absence of source/memory contamination; this review did not consult contamination content carrying exposed results.

findings.title: Declared key is not unique
findings.problem: The schema declares SHEET as the key, but raw source rows 42 and 168 both contain SHEET=407. They are distinct full records: there is one duplicated-key extra row, two affected rows, and zero exact duplicate source records. The analysis correctly preserves both using row_id, so this does not alter current numerical estimates.
findings.fix: Declare row_id as the processed-data key and SHEET as a source identifier that is not unique; update schema/provenance hashes and rerun generated metadata.
